decisions.reason: As an adjacent product for machine-tool fluid management, it fits the firm’s modular core business and sunk engineering/launch effort makes management more likely to continue unless clear failure is visible, which it is not.

Because the hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm’s established filtration offer, prior investment and strategic fit strongly favor continued commitment despite limited later website evidence.

The gravity band coolant filter is close to the firm’s existing coolant filtration portfolio, so management is likely to retain it and treat any weak signals after launch as temporary rather than grounds for withdrawal.
